name: icbt-campus-carpool-system
description: Full-stack Carpooling & Fuel Quota Transit Application for ICBT Students & Staff (SEN5002 Agile & DevOps)

scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm run deploy
scripts.deploy: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.cpSync('frontend/dist', 'backend/public', {recursive:true, force:true}); console.log('Deployed frontend to backend/public');"
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
